items.title: Kobe Stewart, Hornets Agree To Training Camp Deal
items.content:
The Charlotte Hornets and wing Kobe Stewart have agreed to an Exhibit 10 contract. This is a training camp deal for Stewart that is set up for him to join the Greensboro Swarm of the G League after the preseason.

Stewart played in 46 G League games last season split between the Wisconsin Herd, Austin Spurs and Memphis Hustle. The 6-foot-6 wing averaged 7.7 points on 45.5% shooting and 3.2 rebounds in 20 minutes per game.
